objective: One final evaluation of the validation-locked SIRCH configuration on the cleaned test split.
decision_rule: A video is positive when at least one complete rolling mean of K=7 consecutive sequence scores is greater than or equal to theta=0.70.
score_generation: Same implementation as validation selection: 20-frame windows, stride 5, EfficientNetB0 features and the locked temporal head.
short_clip_policy: Repeat the last frame exactly as in validation selection so all validation candidate K values were comparable.
